generator.provenance: MIT synthetic data; no user, CodeGG, network, or downloaded data

splitting.method: sdm-data deterministic leakage-group split with six complete test families
splitting.excluded_families: all counterfactual pair members remain in one group and one split

candidates.binary_selection: constant-mask selected on train/dev due sub-0.001 maximum dev text/load/combined nuisance deltas and dev Brier 0.000000775; baseline dev Brier 0.000000357 but dev note-only and combined maximum probability deltas exceed 0.99. L2=0.01 is screened and not selected (dev Brier 0.02477). No test rows or labels used.
candidates.choice_selection: compositional architecture fixed as the prospective candidate based on train/dev loss 0.000460, answerable accuracy 1.0, 53/53 counterfactual pairs correct on both sides, and 1.0 no-answer recall; legacy and cross remain frozen comparators. No test rows or labels used.
candidates.screening_budget: 3 Binary fits and 3 Choice fits; no seed, epoch, L2, architecture, or threshold search after this freeze

binary_gates.primary_metric: group-mean Brier improvement (comparator Brier minus candidate Brier)
binary_gates.critical_threshold: adjusted 95% lower confidence bound > 0 versus both training-prior constant and frozen legacy incumbent
binary_gates.id_noninferiority_threshold: adjusted 95% lower confidence bound >= -0.02 versus legacy incumbent
binary_gates.load_and_unknown_vocab: reported as label-preserving negative controls; no post-test retuning

choice_gates.primary_threshold: adjusted 95% lower confidence bound > 0 for candidate minus each frozen comparator on identical answerable groups
choice_gates.load_and_unknown_vocab: reported as label-preserving negative controls; no post-test retuning

uncertainty.method: paired leakage-group percentile bootstrap; draw whole groups and keep counterfactual pairs together
uncertainty.multiplicity: one-sided Bonferroni across 18 preregistered primary and guardrail claims; alpha=0.05/18
uncertainty.interval_direction: lower bounds are the conservative direction for improvement, noninferiority, pair correctness, and no-answer recall

disposition.positive: all required support, primary, critical OOD, counterfactual, abstention, noninferiority, resource, and negative-control gates pass
disposition.negative: an adequately supported preregistered critical gate fails
disposition.indeterminate: otherwise, including insufficient support or inconclusive adjusted intervals
disposition.scope: synthetic task qualification only; not real-world generalization, CodeGG promotion, publication, or deployment approval

one_time_test_rule: Run the frozen final candidate set once after this protocol, membership manifest, code, candidate artifacts, and support reports are committed. Never rerun, retune, or alter gates based on test outcomes; any later candidate requires a new independent cohort.
